text.title: sql-optimization Procedure
text.summary: Seven-step procedure to apply the sql-optimization methodology end-to-end. Each step lists input, action, output and an optional decision gate.

step.name: rank-queries-by-impact
step.action: Sort by total_time = mean_time * calls; pick top 5.

step.name: capture-explain-baseline
step.action: Run EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) on production-sized data; record output.

step.name: investigate-estimate-skew
step.action: Compare actual rows against estimated at every node. Where the ratio exceeds 10x, run ANALYZE on the table and re-capture the plan; if the skew survives, raise the column statistics target and ANALYZE again.
step.output: a plan whose estimates describe the data
step.decision-gate: Do not propose an index while an unexplained 10x skew remains — the planner is choosing on numbers that are wrong, and no index changes that.

step.name: propose-changes
step.action: Author composite / covering / partial indexes + query rewrites; explicit columns instead of SELECT *.
step.decision-gate: If write workload is heavy, weigh index cost before adding.

step.name: apply-and-remeasure
step.action: Apply to staging; re-run EXPLAIN ANALYZE; capture after numbers.

step.name: synthesize-report
step.action: Compose the Markdown + JSON report; validate against the schema in 02-output-contract.xml.

step.name: regression-gate
step.input: before vs after plans and timings
step.action: Compare wall-clock over the recorded sample size, not a single run. If the change shows no improvement, or a write-path regression, revert it rather than merging it "since it is already written".
step.output: merge / revert decision recorded in the report
step.decision-gate: No measurable improvement and no documented exception blocks the merge. Rule regression-gate-before-merge.

step.name: ship-safely
step.action: Create the index with CONCURRENTLY outside a transaction (see `templates/create_index_concurrently.sql`), then check `pg_index` for an INVALID index left behind by a failed build and REINDEX CONCURRENTLY if one exists.
step.output: a live, valid index and a post-deploy plan confirming the planner uses it
